comment: Questions for the retrieval benchmark, in the mix they actually arrive in: Roman Urdu, Hinglish and English. `expect` is a substring that must survive into the delivered context for the answer to be reachable. Edit this file to tune the benchmark; never edit thresholds in code to make it pass.

documents.title: Yasir Bhai
documents.summary: Trade finance client, Together We Go
documents.body:
# Yasir Bhai
Met through [[iftikhar]] in 2024. Runs Together We Go, a trade finance outfit in Lahore, and talks in long voice notes.

## Retainer
PKR 40,000 monthly, invoiced on the first. Raised from 30,000 in March 2026.

## Channel
WhatsApp voice notes only. He does not read email and will not use Slack.

## History
Started with one-off dashboards billed hourly through 2024 before the retainer.

documents.title: PowerNet Manager
documents.body:
# PowerNet Manager
Production ISP billing and customer dashboard.

## Scale
Serves 4,491 active customers across three franchises.

## Stack
Next.js front end on Supabase, deployed to the Oracle ARM64 box behind Coolify.

## Open problems
Invoice PDF generation times out past 800 rows and needs batching.

documents.title: FlowDesk
documents.body:
# FlowDesk
The flagship: a local-first Electron AI workstation.

## Capture engine
Reverse-engineers AI provider APIs from real network traffic rather than guessed wire formats, so no API keys are needed.

## Brain
SQLite knowledge store with FTS5, scope inheritance and a deterministic retrieval ladder.

## Agent
Claude Agent SDK drives worker tools for ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Perplexity through logged-in browser sessions.

documents.title: Iftikhar
documents.body:
# Iftikhar
Co-founded [[codveon]] with me. Handles client hunting and the student internship pipeline while I build.

documents.title: Codveon
documents.body:
# Codveon
Small agency, two founders.

## Model
Student interns are trained on real client work, then the good ones convert to paid contractors.

## Rate floor
We do not take fixed-price work below 150,000 PKR after the 2025 scope-creep losses.

documents.title: Skills
documents.body:
# Skills

## Intermediate
Flutter, Supabase, Next.js, Node, Electron, Claude Agent SDK, web API reverse engineering.

## Learning
FastAPI, Python, RAG and vector databases.

## Weak
Manual coding syntax is not the primary approach; I direct agents in Roman Urdu instead.

documents.title: Oracle VPS
documents.body:
# Oracle VPS
ARM64, 4 cores, 24GB, always-free tier.

## Running
Docker under Coolify, Nginx, WireGuard, iptables. Ollama and Open WebUI for local models.

## Gotcha
The ARM64 build of Chromium is not available in the default Playwright image, so browser jobs run elsewhere.

documents.title: No API keys for provider capture
documents.summary: Capture from the browser session instead
documents.body:
# No API keys for provider capture
Decided in 2025.

## Reason
Paying per token for five providers while already subscribing to them is waste. Capture the logged-in browser session instead.

## Cost
Every provider UI change can break capture, so wire formats must be verified against real traffic, never guessed.
